Heat therapy, infrared therapy, and red light therapy are all popular options for managing aches and pain, but how do they compare? Learn how each works, their potential benefits, and how to choose the best option for your needs.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
